svg.text: Code-accurate architecture · Libri2Mix 16 kHz · J = 2 speakers · R = 4 reconstruction stages
A. End-to-end architecture and multi-scale separator
single mixture stream · Bᴱ=2 Global/Local pairs per stage
hᵦ: (B × 128 × Tₚ/16) · no downsample · no PARR
8 heads · dₖ=16 · Pₖ: (Tᵦ × Tᵦ × 16), Tᵦ=Tₚ/16 → every Global Transformer
same module/weights at all five scales
speaker-wise shared processing · Bᴰ=3 Global/Local/CS triplets per stage
After all Global / Local / Cross-Speaker processing of every decoder stage
H′ᵣ feeds the next stage; one shared temporal core, with stage-specific Nᵣ and γᵣ
Stage index r=0,1,2,3 corresponds to Tᵣ={Tₚ/8, Tₚ/4, Tₚ/2, Tₚ}
PARR treats BJ as batch-like branches; it adds no cross-speaker operation
B. PARRᵣ detail — exact forward path
Input/output use channel-first convention. Cᵦ=64; the zero-initialized controller produces a channel-temporal gate.
PW projection → DWConv K3,d → PReLU → Dropout
Shared θ,φ across all r and all BJ branches: Bθ, Conv-U×2, FSMN, Correction Norm, Gφ, Wθ
Pure correction: there is no Zᵣ+Rᵣ inside the temporal core; the only outer residual is Hᵣ+γᵣΔᵣ.
All three blocks preserve (· × 128 × T); residual units use LayerScale and dropout.
adaptive avg-pool to Tᵦ → MHSA(8 heads + RPE)
MHSA 8 heads, no positional encoding + residual
G = Global Transformer · L = Local Transformer · CS = Cross-Speaker Transformer · PW/DW = point/depth-wise convolution
Architecture source: SepReformer paper and repository code; PARR source: models/SepReformer_PARR_Libri2Mix_16K/modules/module.py and configs.yaml
